This website presents one practical tutorial for data-science students: how to turn live web data into a tidy dataset with Python.

## From API to DataFrame

### Collecting College Football Scores with Python

In this tutorial, you will learn how to request college football scoreboard data, navigate nested JSON, and organize the results in a `pandas` DataFrame. It is designed for readers with approximately the data-science background of a STAT 386 student.
